title: What it costs to make electricity, by source
notes: Levelized cost of energy (LCOE): the average cost of each megawatt-hour over a plant's life, covering building, financing, fuel and upkeep, with no federal tax credits. Ranges reflect different sites, sizes and financing. These are national estimates for a new plant, not Virginia bills: they leave out transmission, grid upgrades and backup needs. 1 MWh = 1,000 kWh, so $100/MWh is 10 cents per kWh.
